Markets.title: US mortgage rates brush 7%, weighing on buyers, sellers and further straining a bleak housing market
Markets.summary: US average 30-year fixed mortgage rates rose to 6.95%, reaching their highest level since January 2025. This increase in borrowing costs is reducing housing affordability and further slowing down home sales.

Markets.title: SEC gives tokenized stock trading platforms five-year regulatory relief
Markets.summary: The US SEC has granted a five-year regulatory exemption to platforms that offer tokenized stock trading. This decision allows blockchain-based platforms to facilitate 24/7 trading, instant settlements, and fractional ownership while maintaining investor protections.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Friday
Markets.summary: Indian equities ended mixed on Thursday, with the Sensex slipping 22 points and the Nifty gaining 53 points after volatile trading. Mid- and small-cap stocks outperformed, driven by buying interest in sectors like capital goods, defence, and power.

Markets.title: Sebi bars Kore Digital promoters over alleged Rs 541 crore revenue misstatement
Markets.summary: Market regulator Sebi has barred Kore Digital and three executives after finding evidence of a Rs 541 crore revenue misstatement and alleged fund diversion. The regulator has also blocked the company's main-board migration and ordered a forensic audit of its records.

Markets.title: Fed builds credibility, but hawkish turn leaves investors edgy
Markets.summary: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time since 2023, signaling a hawkish shift in its inflation policy. This unanimous decision has made investors edgy and caused bond yields to fluctuate as they brace for potential future rate increases.

Markets.title: CoreWeave launches $3 billion convertible debt sale
Markets.summary: CoreWeave is launching a $3 billion convertible debt offering and an at-the-market stock sale to fund its artificial intelligence infrastructure. This capital-raising strategy aims to strengthen the company's credit profile and support ongoing operations amid rising financial demands in the AI sector.

Geo-Political.title: Canada welcomes EU proposal to become 'associate member'
Geo-Political.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney welcomed a European Union proposal for Canada to become an associate member. Carney stated that this proposed alliance between Canada and the EU would create a beacon for other democracies.

Geo-Political.title: Ninth woman's body found as South African police investigate string of deaths
Geo-Political.summary: South African police have discovered the body of a ninth woman, prompting fear among local residents. Investigators are currently examining whether the string of deaths across the area are connected.

Geo-Political.title: UN experts say grounds to believe US committed war crimes in Iran strikes
Geo-Political.summary: UN experts state there are grounds to believe the United States committed war crimes during February strikes on a primary school in Minab and a sports complex in Lamerd. The U.S. has not acknowledged carrying out these deadly attacks in Iran.

Geo-Political.title: Hyrox athlete apologises for continuing race after soiling herself
Geo-Political.summary: Joanna Wietrzyk has apologized for continuing to compete in a Hyrox fitness race last week after soiling herself. She has also forfeited her victory in the competition.

Geo-Political.title: Wife of US scholar jailed in China asks Trump to raise arrest at Xi meeting
Geo-Political.summary: Sylvia Zin and other family members of individuals imprisoned in China are asking President Trump to raise these arrests with China's leader during their upcoming meeting next week. Zin is specifically seeking Trump's help to secure the release of her husband, a US scholar currently jailed in China.

Geo-Political.title: Assad regime planned US journalist's kidnap for weeks, BBC finds
Geo-Political.summary: A former Syrian regime insider claims that Bashar al-Assad personally approved the planned abduction of American journalist Austin Tice. This revelation comes from a new investigation by the BBC regarding the long-term disappearance of Tice in Syria.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: The author discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when querying ChatGPT in 2025. This visibility was achieved without paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This guide outlines the top 10 AI tools designed to help creators improve their digital content production in 2025. These essential technologies are revolutionizing the content creation process and making creators' workflows more efficient.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transformed from a file-sharing service into a generative AI platform for creating content. The platform allows users to generate AI media while providing tools to share and monetize their work.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights ten advanced artificial intelligence tools used across various industries in 2023. These technologies are designed to automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and boost overall productivity.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This article outlines the top ten AI content generator and writer tools available in 2022 to help users efficiently create engaging and relevant material. Because many options exist on the market, the guide helps readers determine which tool best fits their specific needs.

AI & Tech.title: Beginner Guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This beginner's guide to CJ Affiliate explains how the network works and how to earn money on the platform. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs and alternative platforms.

Data & Insights.title: Centre to hold state finance ministers’ conference ahead of GST Council meeting
Data & Insights.summary: The Centre is hosting a conference for state finance ministers on October 7 to discuss financing India's path toward Viksit Bharat ahead of the GST Council meeting. This event also precedes the official start of pre-budget consultations for the Union Budget 2027-28 on October 12.

Data & Insights.title: PM Modi turns 76: Demonetisation, GST, PLI, Jan Dhan and more – Key economic policies rolled out since 2014
Data & Insights.summary: Since taking office in May 2014, Prime Minister Narendra Modi has implemented major economic reforms, including demonetisation, GST, and the PLI scheme. His administration has also overseen widespread welfare expansion, technological transformation, and significant national-security and foreign policy shifts.

Data & Insights.title: Exclusive | Big change soon in how people earn, invest as salaried white-collar jobs set to decline: Saurabh Mukherjea
Data & Insights.summary: Saurabh Mukherjea warns that artificial intelligence will soon automate repetitive white-collar jobs and reshape the employment landscape in India. This shift is expected to decline traditional salaried positions and promote a greater reliance on gig work.

Data & Insights.title: India’s US Treasury purchases surge to $15.2 billion in July, highest holdings in 10 months
Data & Insights.summary: In July, India increased its US Treasury holdings by $15.2 billion, reaching its highest level in 10 months. This surge was driven by large capital inflows attracted through the central bank's special overseas investment facilities.

Data & Insights.title: India flags impact on ties, energy markets from US law on Russian oil imports
Data & Insights.summary: The U.S. House passed a bipartisan sanctions bill that gives the president power to impose up to 100% tariffs on countries like India and China for buying Russian energy. India warned that this legislation could negatively impact bilateral relations and global energy markets.

Data & Insights.title: In charts: How India’s Russian oil imports shifted amid US tariff flip-flops
Data & Insights.summary: India's reliance on Russian oil has surged as it navigates energy-security diversification. The nation now faces potential 100% US tariffs under new legislation targeting buyers of Russian energy.

India.title: 17-Year-Old Raped, Stabbed To Death In Delhi
India.summary: A 17-year-old girl in Delhi was sexually assaulted and stabbed to death by acquaintances inside a tempo after they drank together. The accused individuals then disposed of her body.

India.title: 6-Month-Old Critical After Pit Bull Attack In Haryana's Sonipat, CCTV Captures Horror
India.summary: A six-month-old baby is in critical condition after being attacked by a Pit Bull in Sonipat, Haryana. CCTV footage captured the dog dragging the infant on the road as bystanders attempted to pull it away.

India.title: Call For 9% Sub-Quota For Bhils Out Of ST Share, High Court Issues Notices
India.summary: Petitioners have asked the High Court to grant a 9 percent sub-quota for the Bhil community from the existing Scheduled Tribe reservation in India. They claim the current quota disproportionately benefits the Meena community while leaving the Bhils with inadequate representation.

India.title: PM Modi's Teacher Recalls Sharp Memory, Courage, And A Baby Crocodile
India.summary: Prime Minister Modi's former science teacher, HC Patel, remembered him as a courageous student with a sharp memory during his school years in Vadnagar. Patel also recalled an incident where a young Modi brought a baby crocodile home.

India.title: Tata Sons' Trust Issue: Two-Pronged Row Goes Beyond The Chair
India.summary: The current conflict at Tata Sons involves a dispute over whether N Chandrasekaran should remain as executive chairman. Beyond this leadership question, the controversy also involves at least one additional, unresolved issue.

India.title: 2 Rajya Sabha Members Made Special Invitees To Joint Panel On FCRA Bill
India.summary: Two Rajya Sabha members were appointed as special invitees to the joint parliamentary committee examining the Foreign Contribution Regulation Act (FCRA) Bill. Joint and select committees are temporarily formed to review specific bills and dissolve after submitting their reports.

General.title: Remains found after wildfire identified as mother-of-three missing since 2019
General.summary: Human remains found following a wildfire have been identified as Joanne Sheen, a mother-of-three who had been missing since 2019. A 56-year-old man has been arrested in connection with the case in London.

General.title: Charles 'sounded giddily elated' after Diana died, Earl Spencer claims
General.summary: Earl Spencer claims in a new book that King Charles sounded giddily elated following the death of Princess Diana. Buckingham Palace has strongly pushed back against these claims.

General.title: Interest rates held but Bank signals rise if energy prices stay high
General.summary: The Bank of England has kept interest rates on hold for the sixth consecutive time. However, the Bank warns that sustained high energy prices make a future rate increase more likely.

General.title: Father's tribute to 'sweetest little boy' Noah Woods
General.summary: Rhys Woods has paid tribute to his three-year-old son, Noah Woods, following the boy's death. He also expressed his deepest gratitude to the local community for their support.

General.title: King Charles warns of 'existential danger' of AI falling into wrong hands
General.summary: King Charles warned that artificial intelligence poses an existential danger if it falls into the wrong hands. He made these remarks during a Scottish summit attended by representatives from major AI companies like Nvidia, OpenAI, and Anthropic.

General.title: Warm words on Canada's EU 'associate membership' but no guarantees
General.summary: European officials have reacted positively to the concept of Canada gaining "associate membership" in the European Union. However, there is currently no certainty that this proposal will be implemented or serve as a model for other nations.
